intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are both recorded in Ludhiana, but they do not offer the same kind of {{course}} on this page. We compare what our database holds, and we flag what is missing, after opening official sites in {{year}}.

College of Nursing, Dayanand Medical College vs CT University is a subject mismatch as much as a campus choice. DMC's listed master's programmes are in nursing. CT University's listed MSc programmes here are in other fields, not nursing.

sections.heading: DMC College of Nursing vs CT University for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose the College of Nursing at Dayanand Medical College if you want an M.Sc in a nursing specialisation such as medical-surgical, paediatric, obstetric, psychiatric, community health or critical-care practitioner work.
Choose CT University only if you want one of the non-nursing MSc subjects listed here, such as microbiology, biochemistry, clinical research or psychology, and you have confirmed the current fee.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: The College of Nursing at DMC has no fee row in our table. A missing fee is not a free seat. Use the official notice on the DMC nursing college site before you budget.

For CT University the lowest raw row is ₹5,000, but that is an exam fee, not tuition. Recorded tuition ranges from ₹76,000 a year for M.Sc Psychology to ₹1.10 lakh a year for M.Sc Fashion Design, with a ₹13,000 one-time head on several programmes.
Do not compare DMC's empty fee cell with CT University's exam fee. They are not comparable numbers, and the degrees themselves differ.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no MSc placement row for 2020 or later on either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Nursing graduates often look at hospital roles in Ludhiana and beyond; CT University's listed MSc subjects lead to different jobs. Ask each campus for a recent, programme-specific report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. M.Sc Nursing admissions usually need a recognised B.Sc Nursing and a registration, while a general MSc follows the university's postgraduate rules.

If you want nursing, start with the DMC College of Nursing admissions note. If you want a general MSc, use CT University's official list, and do not assume a nursing seat exists there just because this page pairs the two.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Our table records both campuses in Ludhiana, even though the article slug mentions Firozpur. Use the city in the comparison table when you plan travel.
DMC's nursing college sits with a large teaching hospital. CT University is a private university campus. The daily setting, clinical exposure and peer group will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick the College of Nursing at Dayanand Medical College if an M.Sc Nursing specialisation is the degree you actually want, and you have the official fee in hand.
Pick CT University if your subject is one of the non-nursing MSc programmes listed here, and you budget from the recorded tuition, not from the ₹5,000 exam fee.
If you opened this page looking for two nursing master's departments, stop and re-read the programme lists. That overlap is not in our table.

faqs.question: Does CT University offer the same M.Sc Nursing programmes as DMC Ludhiana?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. DMC's listed programmes are nursing specialisations. CT University's listed MSc programmes include microbiology, biochemistry, clinical research, psychology, hotel management and fashion design.

faqs.question: Is the CT University MSc fee only ₹5,000?
faqs.answer: No. That ₹5,000 row is an exam fee. Recorded tuition is ₹76,000 a year for M.Sc Psychology and up to ₹1.10 lakh a year for M.Sc Fashion Design, plus a ₹13,000 one-time amount on several programmes.

faqs.question: What is the M.Sc Nursing fee at Dayanand Medical College?
faqs.answer: Our table has no fee row for the College of Nursing at DMC. Check the official fee notice on the nursing college site before you budget.

faqs.question: Are placement figures available?
faqs.answer: No. We have no 2020 or later MSc placement row for either campus. Ask the colleges for a recent, programme-specific report.

faqs.question: Is CT University in Firozpur or Ludhiana?
faqs.answer: The article slug mentions Firozpur, but our comparison table records CT University in Ludhiana, the same city as DMC. Use the table city when you plan a visit.

faqs.question: Which college should a nursing graduate choose?
faqs.answer: The College of Nursing at DMC is the side that lists M.Sc Nursing specialisations. CT University, on this page, is a match only if you want one of its non-nursing MSc subjects.
